// /features/text/logic.ts
export type TextTransformKind = "upper" | "lower" | "title";

export interface TextAnalysis {
  chars: number;
  words: number;
  lines: number;
}

export interface TextTransformResult {
  kind: TextTransformKind;
  output: string;
  analysis: TextAnalysis;
}

export const analyzeText = (text: string): TextAnalysis => {
  const chars = [...text].length;
  const words = text.trim().length === 0 ? 0 : text.trim().split(/\s+/).length;
  const lines = text.length === 0 ? 0 : text.split(/\r?\n/).length;
  return { chars, words, lines };
};

export const toTitleCase = (text: string): string => {
  const words = text.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (words.length === 0) {
    return "";
  }
  return words
    .map((word) => {
      if (word.length === 0) {
        return "";
      }
      const lower = word.toLowerCase();
      const head = lower.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      return head + lower.slice(1);
    })
    .join(" ");
};

export const transformText = (
  text: string,
  kind: TextTransformKind
): TextTransformResult => {
  const output =
    kind === "upper"
      ? text.toUpperCase()
      : kind === "lower"
        ? text.toLowerCase()
        : toTitleCase(text);

  return {
    kind,
    output,
    analysis: analyzeText(output),
  };
};

export const formatTextSummary = (
  result: TextTransformResult,
  source: string
): string => {
  const kindLabel =
    result.kind === "upper"
      ? "Uppercase"
      : result.kind === "lower"
        ? "Lowercase"
        : "Title case";
  const sourceAnalysis = analyzeText(source);

  const lines: string[] = [
    `Transformation: ${kindLabel}`,
    ``,
    `Transformed output:`,
    ``,
    result.output || "(empty)",
    ``,
    `Counts (source):`,
    `  Characters: ${sourceAnalysis.chars}`,
    `  Words: ${sourceAnalysis.words}`,
    `  Lines: ${sourceAnalysis.lines}`,
    ``,
    `Counts (output):`,
    `  Characters: ${result.analysis.chars}`,
    `  Words: ${result.analysis.words}`,
    `  Lines: ${result.analysis.lines}`,
  ];

  return lines.join("\n");
};
